title: Shopee seller/buyer requests (reschedule, bring forward, returns, address change)
keywords: shopee reschedule bring forward already accepted repost cancel return address change admin cancel
body: Bring forward same day: no top-up; returns to the original date when the slot expires.
Reschedule ≥1 day ahead: log in the Move-over sheet; treat as a first attempt on the new date.
Already accepted: not rescheduled — advise the seller to decline the buyer's request.
Repost after customer cancel or failed pickup: seller reposts. If the agent used a wrong reason, repost and block the agent.
Agent cancels for other reasons: auto-reposted; if not, report to IT. Admin cancel: always with remarks.
Returns: return status = Shopee cancels; no repost. Same-day seller return and recipient-initiated returns carry a fee. Agents may not refuse.
Address change: before acceptance only, unless the agent agrees.
